title: gloss-signature/v2
description: nodes/<id>/gloss/signed/<hash>-<n>.yaml or targets/<id>/gloss/signed/<hash>-<n>.yaml (F20-R8; D-3 v3.30): a steward's or curator's signature on one gloss version, affirming one sentence — I have read this against the Lean it names, and it says what the Lean says. It changes no grade, status or digestion state. Signed with the signer's own SSH key over the canonical body (opn_gate.signed), as explainer signatures are. v2 adds sections: a signature approves the sections it names (F21-R13, D-3 v3.31). Versioned, never edited (D-34).

node.description: The node, or null for a definition module's gloss.

gloss.description: The SHA-256 of the gloss file signed — its name under gloss/.

signer.description: The signer's GitHub login. At Stage 0 a real-identity contributor is an active steward of the target or a listed curator (F15-Q4).

sections.description: The sections this signature approves and verifies (F21-R13; D-3 v3.31), by key; absent approves every section of the version.

items.description: A section's key (F21-R11): overview for an explainer's unanchored first section, whole for a gloss, else steps: and the section's step ids, sorted, comma-separated.
